subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Google Vertex ADC setup contract: permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, setup-written project/location/default model/marker, and core fallback transport default?
rationale: The remaining choice changes provider auth/setup semantics and fallback ownership rather than fixing a purely local defect that automation can safely decide.

options.title: Accept the ADC setup contract
options.body: Land this path as the intended Google Vertex onboarding contract, including permissive evidence, request-time credential validation, global/default-model writes, and the core fallback routing helper.

options.title: Narrow the auth/default behavior
options.body: Require the PR to keep stricter setup-time evidence or reduce default config writes while preserving the proven onboarding flow.

options.title: Pause behind the Vertex cluster
options.body: Use this PR as proof but wait for maintainers to settle the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60736 provider-boundary decisions first.

recommendation.title: Accept the ADC setup contract
recommendation.body: Land this path as the intended Google Vertex onboarding contract, including permissive evidence, request-time credential validation, global/default-model writes, and the core fallback routing helper.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged production ADC transport work from this owner is the strongest feature-history signal for the request-time Google Vertex auth behavior this PR depends on.
